title: Nanocomposites based on a multicomponent polyurethane/poly(hydroxypropyl methacrylate) polymer matrix and nanofiller hydroxy-POSS as potential noise and vibration damping materials
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,37965-37978
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03574K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Lyudmyla Karabanova, Nataliia Babkina, Dmytro Klimchuk, Lyubov Honcharova
The nanocomposites demonstrate broad maximum of mechanical loss, which is result of forced phase compatibility and large interphase layers. The nanocomposites have a perspective as effective noise and vibration damping materials.
